messages:
maria: Heads up — our Expo sample app started blowing up on fast refresh only in dev. Hermes stacktrace shows crypto.getRandomValues -> 'no secure RNG available'. Works fine in production builds. Anyone seen this?

sam: yup saw something similar last week. usually it's caused by double polyfilling getRandomValues (rn-get-random-values + a small inlined polyfill) plus Metro caching weirdness. fast refresh can re-evaluate modules in a way that loses native bindings.

alex: can you paste the minimal repro? metro config / package.json fields often matter — if metro pulls the CJS bundle that `require()`s node crypto you can hit runtime differences.

maria: repro: expo init -> add @redwood/inference (local workspace link) -> run `expo start` -> open on simulator -> trigger hot reload -> error. stack: ```TypeError: crypto.getRandomValues is not a function
at getRandom (/app/node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/rn/index.js:45:12)
at Object.<anonymous> (/app/App.js:10:5)```

sam: two quick checks: 1) does the package expose a dedicated react-native entry (exports["react-native"]) ? 2) are you using react-native-get-random-values and calling `import 'react-native-get-random-values'` before any libs that call crypto?

maria: package.json for @redwood/inference in the monorepo has "main": "dist/index.cjs.js" and an exports field that maps "./package.json" but no react-native export. we added react-native-get-random-values at app boot but still repro.

alex: ok that explains it — Metro prefers the main/cjs file unless there's a react-native export. If the cjs bundle expects Node builtins and conditionally polyfills at import-time you can get a race during fast refresh where the RN polyfill isn't applied yet. two workarounds:
- add an explicit exports map entry: `"react-native": "./dist/rn/index.js"` and publish a small RN-specific build that imports the RN polyfill early; or
- in your app entry ensure `import 'react-native-get-random-values'` is literally the first import (and disable lazy reload for that file).

oliver: also check Metro's haste/cache — if fast refresh restores a module from cache that was compiled against the CJS path it might still assume `global.crypto` exists. I fixed a similar issue by adding a tiny module at `src/rn/monkeypatch.ts` with: ```
if (!globalThis.crypto) {
  // minimal polyfill used only in dev
  const rn = require('react-native-get-random-values');
  // rn sets global.crypto.getRandomValues
}
``` and referencing that file from the react-native entry so it always runs first.

maria: nice. for typings, we had a separate weirdness: TS complains when importing the package as `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` in RN app unless tsconfig has `esModuleInterop`. The package's d.ts is `export = Redwood` shape. Any tips?

sam: publish ES module typings and set `types` to `dist/index.d.ts`. Also add `exports` with conditional exports for `import` and `require` so bundlers pick the ESM entry for modern toolchains: ```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js",
    "react-native": "./dist/rn/index.js"
  }
}
``` That usually clears up TS+Metro resolution.

alex: small gotcha: Metro currently doesn't respect the `exports` field in some older versions. If your users run an older Expo SDK, you might need an intermediate `react-native` field in package.json root or a `react-native` entry file at package root that re-exports the RN bundle to be safe.

maria: going to try: add rn export + tiny rn entry that imports react-native-get-random-values first + bump sample tsconfig to use esModuleInterop. will report back. thanks! :pray:

devex-bot: CI alert — sample-app-e2e failed on iOS expo workflow (flake) — possible related to fast refresh / caching. Opening ticket #824.

maria: filed #824 with repro steps, linking here. if anyone has a quick patch we can hotfix the sample in the monorepo to avoid blocking onboarding.

sam: I can draft a tiny PR: add `src/rn/setup-rn-polyfills.js` and update package.json exports/react-native. will ping when ready. :rocket:
